name: Stockholm Arlanda Airport

runway.v: three runways: 01L/19R 3,301 m x 45 m; 01R/19L and 08/26 each 2,500 m x 45 m

slots.v: coordinated by Airport Coordination Sweden; only government, humanitarian and emergency flights and helicopters are exempt; slot approval does not replace the flight plan or handling request
slots.quote: Changes or cancellations of SLOT requests must be communicated without delay.

handling.v: all flights need a handling or self-handling agreement
handling.quote: All flights to and from STOCKHOLM/Arlanda are subject to mandatory handling or self-handling agreements.

noise.v: night runway limits: RWY 01R not available for landing 22:00-06:00 local; no more than idle reverse thrust in that period except for safety
noise.quote: RWY 01R is not available for landing 2100-0500 (2000-0400)

notes: Read: Swedish AIP AD 2 ESSA in the LFV AIRAC AIP AMDT 3-2026 package (14 May 2026; pages dated 12 Jun 2025 to 19 Mar 2026); a later package may be in force. No general night ban is stated (only night runway and reverse-thrust limits), so curfew is left missing rather than recorded as none. Times read as UTC with summer times in brackets.
